scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run generate
scripts.render:diagrams: rm -rf public/diagrams && mkdir -p public/diagrams/light public/diagrams/dark && plantuml -nometadata -tsvg -o ../public/diagrams/light diagrams/*.puml && plantuml -nometadata -DDARK_THEME=1 -tsvg -o ../public/diagrams/dark diagrams/*.puml
